tips.text: Stop shooting Kril right after a pipe breaks; hits during the freeze can interrupt it so the next pipe never opens.
Bait the freeze slam by circling Kril at two or three body lengths or breaking his line of sight.
Do not expect melee to trigger the freeze; only his hammer slams and throws do.
Use area damage or a shotgun to hit the small coolant pack on his back.
Abort and rerun if Kril goes permanently invulnerable; restarting is the only fix.
Leave the Proboscis Cernos at home; its stagger can break Kril's pipe cycle for good.
Run it solo, or let one squadmate handle Kril alone while the others take Vor.
Start the Miter runs first and grind Polymer, Plastids, Rubedo and Salvage while you wait for drops.
Expect Kril to be the only real complaint; players clear him in one to three minutes once they know the pipe cycle.
